findings.desc: BLOCKER: canStartDevGuard returns true early at 'if (!policy.plan.requireStoryReview) return true' (line 412) BEFORE the parallel-decomposition sub-check (line 425). A profile that does not require story_review (e.g. light) bypasses the hard gate entirely — a story asserting false parallelism under mode=block can enter DEV despite a real overlap. getGuardFailureReason's parallel branch runs unconditionally, so it still reports the block => decision/message PARITY also breaks (guard allows, reason blocks). Fix: restructure so only the review-record checks are gated on requireStoryReview; the fail-open parallel sub-check ALWAYS runs before return true. Add a light-profile + mode=block smoke case.

MAJOR: the review-gate refactor changed 'return (blockerCount ?? issueCount) === 0' (strict zero) into 'if ((blockerCount ?? issueCount) > 0) return false' (line 420) — NOT behavior-equivalent. A signed review with a non-numeric/negative/missing count (e.g. blockerCount=-1, or string '0') is NOT > 0 so it now PASSES the review gate, where the original strict ===0 rejected anything other than numeric zero. getGuardFailureReason line ~819 has the same '> 0' (pre-existing) so for parity both must use strict !==0. Fix: const gateCount = blockerCount ?? issueCount; if (gateCount !== 0) return false; in canStartDevGuard, and !==0 in getGuardFailureReason's review-count check.

MAJOR (express-channel bypass): the parallel hard-block is enforced ONLY by canStartDevGuard on PLAN->DEV. The INIT_CHECK->DEV express channel is guarded by canSkipPlanGuard (machine.ts ~433-446) which NEVER calls parallelDecompositionEnforcedBlock. So a quickPath story (small checklist, no risk signals) reaches DEV with a provable overlap/broad-glob/unreadable-peer block under mode=block WITHOUT refusal — the gate's core property (a provable contradiction blocks DEV entry) is violated on the express door. Also a phantom-message site (getGuardFailureReason renders a parallel message the express guard never enforced). Fix: add the same fail-open parallel sub-check to canSkipPlanGuard; add an express (INIT_CHECK phase) + mode=block + overlap smoke asserting the guard refuses + the reason renders.
